en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a large Gothic-style building with a tall, ornate clock tower. The building features elaborate stonework, pointed arches, and decorative roof details. There are several people and a horse-drawn cart visible in the foreground. The upper right reads 'Bruges — L'Académie.' and there is some vertical text on the left side indicating the production details.
